enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +28: Passive: +28 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Radiance +145: Passive: +145 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Radiance Lore +21: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Evocation Focus +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Brazen Brilliance: With this item equipped, your offensive attacks and spells have a chance of creating a burst of pure light, dealing Light damage and blinding enemies.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
